summary: Edit gates this HOST declares. The kit ships none: what an edit here may not introduce is this host's policy. Declared empty, every edit is judged and none is refused -- a declared zero, and not a gate that is switched off.

gates.because: the shipped kit serves any runtime through adapters (ADR-014 decision 1); a product name inside kit/ privileges one runtime and every host inherits it.
gates.instead: put product-specific wording in adapters/<id>/ and keep kit/ agnostic.

admits.text: # works with any declared runtime surface
